name: "Fish and Chips" Tacos with Chive Mayo & Crunchy Veggie-Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow potato
½ lemon
½ small pkg chives
½ bunch radish
½ English cucumber
1 yellow bell pepper
½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and small dice potato.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add potato and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and tender, 10-12 minutes. Transfer potatoes to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
parsley flakes
garlic powder
paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, zest lemon into a small bowl. (Cut lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.)

Chop chives into small pieces. Add half to the bowl with the lemon zest along with mayo, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the chive mayo and set aside. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
white wine vinegar
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces. Place in a medium bowl, season with spices, and gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g cod fillet
parsley flakes
garlic powder
paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
white wine vinegar
1 tsp honey
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates. Spread with chive mayo, fill with fish and potatoes, then top with reserved chives. Serve with salad on the side and lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
